observations.help: Desktop modal preserves the four-card guidance structure and cyan-highlighted background regions; current live help copy is contextual and includes Esc dismissal. Narrow dialog fits within the viewport and omits the rail-only card.
observations.recovery404: Recovery title, explanatory copy, and Go to Projects action are present. The current shared-shell header is taller and activity rail starts farther right than in the older Figma frame; the recovery content remains unclipped.

comparison.limits: Figma provides desktop-sized Help and 404 frames only. Exported Help focus state 2298:3560 is a black 360x430 frame with a gold border and does not expose a legible close-control focus rendering; runtime focus behavior was verified independently in Chrome.
